info.title: Storyforge API
info.description: Start and read Storyforge story runs on GitHub Actions. Authenticate with your own GitHub token, or `demo` for sample data.

get.description: The three modes and every input each accepts. Build start forms from this.

schema.title: Response List Modes Api V1 Modes Get

get.description: Story briefs available to start runs with (examples/*.json on the server).

schema.title: Response List Requests Api V1 Requests Get
Response Get Request Api V1 Requests  Request Id  Get

post.description: Check a brief against the pipeline contract without starting anything.

get.description: Confirm the token works and whether it can start runs.

post.description: Start a sequential or parallel run. Returns immediately; follow it with GET /runs/{id}/events.
Recovery mode: continue a failed sequential run.

schema.title: Response Cancel Run Api V1 Runs  Run Id  Cancel Post

get.description: Stream run updates. Browsers must read this with fetch() (EventSource cannot send the token).

200.description: Server-sent events: "run" carries a RunDetail; "end" closes the stream.

get.description: The readable manuscript and per-scene status. 404 until the run uploads it.

can_dispatch.title: Can Dispatch
can_dispatch.description: True when the token can start workflows on the repo.

starts_from.title: Starts From
starts_from.description: "request" modes start from a story brief; "run" modes act on an earlier run.

Progress.title: Progress
Progress.description: total_scenes counts every scene in the brief; a run with a smaller scene_limit stops before it.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: "fresh" starts a new run that reuses the approved prefix; "rerun" re-executes the failed stage inside the original run.

backend.title: Backend
backend.description: Fresh strategy only. Must match the original run.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Fresh strategy only: sequential-mode inputs such as profile or scene_limit.

recoverable.title: Recoverable
recoverable.description: True when POST /runs/{id}/recover can continue this run.

resume_scene.title: Resume Scene
resume_scene.description: For a failed sequential run: the first unfinished scene recovery would restart from.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: Raw review records keyed by reviewer (story, rhetoric, memory, check).

request_file.title: Request File
request_file.description: Name of a brief in examples/ without .json, from GET /requests.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: Other mode inputs listed by GET /modes, e.g. profile or scene_limit.

run_id.title: Run Id
run_id.description: Null when GitHub has not listed the run yet; poll GET /runs?tag=<tracking_tag>.

tracks_run_id.title: Tracks Run Id
tracks_run_id.description: For in-place recovery: the original run whose progress to watch.
